title: Taylor Swift goes wild as Travis Kelce reaches milestone with electric play in Chiefs’ Week 1 win

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Taylor Swift goes wild as Travis Kelce reaches milestone with electric play in Chiefs’ Week 1 win
sources.description: Travis Kelce moved into second all time in receiving yards by a tight end on Monday night when he made a 59-yard catch in the third quarter and whipped Taylor Swift into a frenzy in his box at Arrowhead Stadium.
